name: Views Flipboard
description: A Views display/style that renders results as a Flipboard-like RSS/feed layout.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 Provide views to support for Flipboard RSS format.

 Installation 
 Versions 8.x-1.x : Install as usual, see the official documentation for further information.

 Configuration 
 ToDo : Add steps for how to configure Views: Flipboard module here.

 Try on simplytest.me 

 Requirements 
 Following D8 core modules are required to use Views: Flipboard module.
